description: Point d'arrêt Bus LiO GTFS - Tarn-et-Garonne is a dataset listed in Tarn et Garonne Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Occitanie. Fichier GTFS: points d'arrêt Bus LiO en Tarn-et-Garonne. Coverage: Tarn-et-Garonne. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are bus, gtfs, lio, arrêt. The portal shows 8 records. The portal shows 2022-11-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-82amenagement-fr-portal.
